name: Samsung Galaxy M35 5G
description: Samsung Galaxy M35 5G is a mid-range smartphone featuring a 6.6-inch Super AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, Exynos 1380 processor, 50MP main camera with OIS, 6000mAh battery, 25W charging, and 5G connectivity. It runs on Samsung One UI and offers features for everyday smartphone use, entertainment, photography, and multitasking.
